name: Milwaukee
local_rules: Milwaukee requires an 'Initial Review' with the Parking Citation Review Manager located at the City Tow Lot. As of 2026, Milwaukee has enacted a strict 'Habitual Violator' ordinance: 5 or more citations overdue by 60 days makes a vehicle eligible for towing even if legally parked. Filing an appeal immediately pauses this 'Habitual' clock. If your initial review is denied, you must schedule a formal hearing at the Municipal Court. Milwaukee has a complex 'Night Parking' permit system; if ticketed for a night violation, the Appeal Kit must include proof of a valid permit or your 'Service Request' number if the online system was down. The city's 2026 enforcement push means mailing your contest before the 15-day mark is the only way to avoid the immediate $15-25 late fee jump.
